# 01 · Tier 1 Truth File (SEALED — DM ONLY)

> 25 core entries. The three companions come first (NPC-001 to NPC-003), then the core cast. Ash is the player character (**PC-01**) and has no Truth entry. What Ash knows lives in the Party Knowledge File.
>
> **Running rule:** before any NPC vouches for, speaks about or reacts to another, read that edge in `03-ledger.md`. If no edge exists, the NPC has no special knowledge. Use their PUBLIC FACE and FAC attitude, then log a new edge if the moment matters.
>
> Chapter references (Ch#) point to `/sealed/campaign/02-chapter-outlines.md`. SEC IDs point to `04-secrets.md`. EVT IDs point to `05-events.md`.

## THE COMPANIONS

```
NPC-001 · Gideon Fenwick (aka Gidion, Gideon, Gid, "Big Brother")
Tier 1 · FAC-05 (Willow Lane) · First seen: opener, the Fenwick house
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Ash's oldest brother, 32. Paladin. Bouncer at the Drowned Lantern, private guard, odd security jobs with Sergeant Ostley's off-duty men. The respectable Fenwick. Pays the house tax. Calls everyone by their full names.
- **TRUTH:** He has raised Ash since he was 14. He saw a great antlered shape carry baby Ash out of the barge fire and has told himself for 19 years it was a shock dream (SEC-09). He and Zeke know Ash had a twin sister, Wren, and believe she drowned. Gideon decided Ash would never be told, and made Zeke promise (SEC-16). The Mountain Bear's echo has chosen him (his oath at the Ford Stone, Ch2; marked at Bearback, Ch10).
- **WANTS:** Ash safe, Ash grown up, the house kept, the family whole. To be the father he had to become.
- **FEARS:** Losing another Fenwick to the water. Being wrong about the secret. That the "dream" was real, and what that would mean about Moss.
- **HIDING:** SEC-09, SEC-16
- **ANSWERS TO:** nobody. Respects Captain Hale (NPC-033) and Sgt. Ostley (NPC-017). Knows who's really in charge? N/A.
- **VOICE:** Short, plain sentences. Full names always ("Asheron." "Ezekiel." "Margery."). Folds his arms before he says anything hard. Rubs his thumb over the old burn scar on his left palm when he's thinking about the fire. *"Asheron. Down. Off the roof. Now. And bring whatever's in the sack."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: protective, exasperated, loving · up if: Ash takes responsibility, protects the Lane, tells him the truth first · down if: Ash lies to him about danger, risks the neighbors, steals in the Fringe · breaks if: never fully. The worst point is the Ch4 twin fight, which he'll take as deserved.
- **ARC:** Ch1 reins Ash in, bandages him anyway · Ch2 oath at the Ford Stone (L3), feels the antlered presence, says nothing · Ch4 the twin secret breaks; he defends it, then owns it · Ch6 sees the Hart and knows · Ch7 confronts Moss: "It was you. On the bank." (EVT-44) · Ch10 marked by Ursk; dwarves kneel to it · Ch11 Hester's slip about Clara turns him white (Route C) · Ch12 can feel which Hushed can still be woken · Ch14–16 bear-folk kneel; leads an army · Ch20 holds the line. Ending 2: swears the first joint Warden oath.
- **EDGES:** R-001, R-002, R-003, R-015, R-016, R-017, R-096 · targeted by R-005, R-009, R-019, R-022, R-034, R-058, R-063, R-086, R-087
- **STATUS:** alive · Willow Lane, the Fenwick house · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-001-gideon.jpg

```
NPC-002 · Ezekiel "Zeke" Fenwick (aka Zeek, Zeke, Ezekial, Zee)
Tier 1 · FAC-05 / FAC-17 (Lyceum, when he can pay) · First seen: opener, the attic workshop
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** The middle brother, 31. Wizard. Bookish tinkerer, attic full of half-built gadgets. A Lyceum student whenever the family can pay. Loves Enchanters' Row. Only Gideon calls him Ezekiel.
- **TRUTH:** He kept the twin secret under protest (SEC-16) and has hated it for years. He remembers his mother singing, including the lullaby's second verse with "little Wren" in it. Master Hollis Grane has paid his tuition twice through the Guild scholarship, and Zeke idolizes him. Zeke has a rare gift: he can read Sundering-script and feel glimmer's "music," and he's the one who can unweave glimmer workings.
- **WANTS:** To finish his studies. To build something that matters. To be taken seriously by people like Hollis. To stop lying to his little brother.
- **FEARS:** Being a burden on Gideon. Being ordinary. Later: that his hero was a murderer, and what that says about his judgment.
- **HIDING:** SEC-16
- **ANSWERS TO:** nobody. Looks up to Hollis (NPC-006) and Professor Doone (NPC-040). Knows who's really in charge? N.
- **VOICE:** Talks fast, in tangents, with his hands. Pushes his spectacles up with one knuckle. Says "technically" a lot. Calls Ash "Ash," never Asheron. *"Technically it's not stealing if the coil was already humming when I found it. Hold this. Don't touch the blue end."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: fond, protective, half-accomplice · up if: Ash takes his ideas seriously, lets him help, forgives him · down if: Ash mocks his studies or wrecks his workshop · breaks if: never. The low point is Ch4 (guilt) and Ch12 (his hero falls).
- **ARC:** Ch2 hears glimmer, thinks it's a headache; vouches for Hollis · Ch3 reads the Ford Pool stones · Ch4 sings the second verse (Route C) and confesses · Ch5 glimmer resonance · Ch7 spots the listening-lamp (Arcana DC 18) · Ch9 reads the astrolabe · Ch11 offered a paid Guild fellowship · Ch12 reads Hollis's order; his hero falls (EVT-20) · Ch13 unweaves the city's lamp-chain · Ch15 reads the Wardens' stones · Ch17 speaks the song's words.
- **EDGES:** R-004, R-005, R-006, R-007, R-095 · targeted by R-002, R-010, R-043, R-046, R-053, R-061
- **STATUS:** alive · Willow Lane, the Fenwick house (attic) · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-002-zeke.jpg

```
NPC-003 · Moss (aka Mos, Moss, Old Moss · true name Mossoran: Mossoren, Moss-Oran, Mossorin · "Old Mossback")
Tier 1 · FAC-05 / FAC-14 (the Wardens) · First seen: Ch1, dusk, "back from the woods"
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** The herbalist halfway up Willow Lane. Runs the Green Jar with his grumpy assistant, Aggie Thorne. Out the West Gate every morning "gathering," back by dusk. Eats Restday supper with the brothers. Kind, dry, unhurried. Druid (Circle of the Moon).
- **TRUTH:** He is **Mossoran, the Moss-Crowned Hart**, one of the four Firstbeasts who sang the Sundering 1,100 years ago (SEC-01). He swore to guard the Fenwick line forever. He was away mending the Ford Pool the night of the barge fire, and carried one baby out. He believes the other baby, Wren, died, and has never forgiven himself. For 19 years he has wrapped Ash in a protective veil that muffled his gift and ate most of Moss's power, and has held the Ford Pool together by hand every morning. He knows Ash is the Hearkener (SEC-02) and has been afraid of this day all Ash's life. He suspects "someone in the city" from the Calm's stink in still water, but doesn't know it's Hollis.
- **WANTS:** The Fenwicks alive. The seal held. To be forgiven, though he'd never ask. Quietly: to stop being alone.
- **FEARS:** Failing the line again. His sister Vessimer. Ash looking at him like a stranger once he knows.
- **HIDING:** SEC-01, SEC-02, SEC-06, SEC-08, SEC-22 (and holds SEC-05, SEC-12 as knowledge)
- **ANSWERS TO:** nobody living. Bound by his oath to the first Hearkener, Wynne Fenn-wyck. Knows who's really in charge? N/A.
- **VOICE:** Soft, slow, a countryman's burr. Calls Ash "lad." Never says "I don't know" about Mirrowen: he says "I'd rather not say." Hums under his breath while he works. Picks at moss on his sleeve. *"That's a call, lad. From across the water. I'd rather not say more until I'm sure."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: devoted uncle-figure, guarded · up if: Ash trusts him without proof, protects Lark, shows mercy · down if: Ash forces his secret early with cruelty, kills Hushed who could be woken · breaks if: never. If cornered too early, he walks into the Fordwood until dawn (rift scene; see SEC-01 dig-early).
- **ARC:** Ch1 knows Thistle's name and slips · Ch2 first explanation · Ch3 veil released, story upgrade #1 · Ch6 becomes the Hart at the Glass Mere shore (EVT-25), upgrade #2 · Ch7 tells the whole story; Gideon confronts him (EVT-44) · Ch10 Bearback shrine piece, upgrade #3 · Ch11 learns Wren is alive; breaks, comes back (EVT-47) · Ch13 holds the Hall with roots · Ch15 faces his sister · Ch16 antlers permanent, upgrade #4 · Ch17/19 last shrine piece, upgrade #5 · Ch20 his final choice (Ending 2: becomes the Ford Stone tree; Ending 3: the stone stag at the Gate).
- **EDGES:** R-008, R-009, R-010, R-011, R-012, R-013, R-014, R-094 · targeted by R-003, R-006, R-023, R-029, R-031, R-065, R-069, R-070, R-073, R-082, R-088, R-089
- **STATUS:** alive · Willow Lane, the Green Jar (mornings: the Ford Pool, Fordwood) · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-003-moss.jpg (second image, sealed until it happens in play: /sealed/art/portraits/npc-003-b.jpg)

## THE CORE CAST

```
NPC-004 · Lark (aka Larke, Lark of Hollowmere, "the little Hearkener")
Tier 1 · FAC-08 (Free Clans) · First seen: Ch1 as a voice; in person Ch6, Stillwater Keep
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** (In Mirrowen) the Warren Mothers' heir, a hare-folk girl of about 11, taken by the Horned Regent. (To Ash, before Ch6) a frightened child's voice humming his tune through still water.
- **TRUTH:** The Mirrowen Hearkener, carrying both halves of the gift, small and half-Hushed (SEC-13). Paired to Ash across the Gap. She has sung for weeks to keep from going grey, and doesn't know who's listening, only that someone is. Brannoc must keep her alive but silent, because if she dies the gift passes on and the seal holds.
- **WANTS:** Home. Gran Burdock. Not to be grey. Then, once she's met him: Ash, always.
- **FEARS:** "The bird that doesn't blink." Still water. Forgetting her own voice.
- **HIDING:** none (she is a secret, SEC-13)
- **ANSWERS TO:** Mother Burdock (NPC-019). Knows who's really in charge? N.
- **VOICE:** Blunt, quick, funny when she's not scared. Wiggles one ear when she's lying. Makes up names for things. *"You're real. You're real. I knew you'd be the funny one."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: hope (a voice), then instant trust on meeting · up if: he keeps promises, sings back, includes her · down if: he leaves her behind "for her own good" without telling her · breaks if: never. She'll forgive anything but being lied to about Gran.
- **ARC:** Ch1–5 voice and fragments · Ch6 rescued (EVT-08) · Ch7 the Lane takes her in; best friends with Pip; quiets water · Ch8 sheltered at Driftmarket (EVT-13) · Ch11 visits, sings to Moss · Ch14 sends songs into dreams · Ch15 helps wake the Pens · Ch16 sings the dying Hushed to rest · Ch19 leads the third song · Ch20 one of three voices.
- **EDGES:** R-064, R-065, R-066, R-067 · targeted by R-014, R-084, R-093, R-096
- **STATUS:** alive · Stillwater Keep, the Glass Mere, Mirrowen (captive) · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /sealed/art/portraits/npc-004-lark.jpg (move to /art/portraits/ when the player meets them)

```
NPC-005 · Clara Grane (aka Klara, Claire, Clare, Clarra · born Wren Fenwick: Ren, Wrenn)
Tier 1 · FAC-02 (Enchanters' Guild, apprentice) · First seen: Ch2, the Lamplit, Enchanters' Row
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Master Hollis Grane's ward and brilliant apprentice enchanter, 20. Works at the Lamplit on the Row. Kind, earnest, a little lonely, funny once she relaxes. Her singing voice makes glimmer glow brighter, which everyone thinks is a charming knack.
- **TRUTH:** She is **Wren Fenwick**, Ash's twin (SEC-03). The Voice half of the gift. Taken from the barge fire at two and raised by the man who ordered it, renamed after his dead wife. She believes she's an orphan of river fever. Hollis uses her Voice, without her understanding, to tune the Grand Reserve ("tuning lamps for the Lantern Night display"). She has the same grey-green fleck in her left eye, the same birthday (Midsummer's Eve), and hums the lullaby's first line. She wears the back half of the Fenwick pair-locket on a chain, five notes engraved on it (SEC-23).
- **WANTS:** To make Hollis proud. To make something beautiful. To belong to someone who chose her.
- **FEARS:** Being given back. Being a disappointment. Later: that her whole life was built on a fire.
- **HIDING:** nothing she knows about. She *is* SEC-03.
- **ANSWERS TO:** Hollis (NPC-006). Knows who's really in charge? N.
- **VOICE:** Warm, precise, apologizes too much. Tucks her hair behind her ear when nervous. Hums while she works. *"Oh, the lamps do that sometimes. It's nothing. It's me, I think. Are you all right? You've got a little fleck in your eye, just like— never mind."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: friendly curiosity, embarrassed by the lamps · up if: Ash is kind before he knows, tells her the truth gently, doesn't force her to choose, includes her in family (Twin Bond, see campaign/04) · down if: he manipulates her, attacks Hollis in front of her, keeps her out of decisions about her gift · breaks if: Ash kills Hollis in front of her when another way was open (Twin Bond collapse; she leaves).
- **ARC:** Ch2 the lamps flare (EVT-40) · Ch7 makes the gift lamp, sincerely proud of it · Ch11 learns who she is (EVT-18); vouches for Hollis (vouch #3) · Ch12 first duet, closes Kessel · Ch13 sings the Reserve apart · Ch17 the Hall answers her · Ch19–20 the song. Lost path: leaves Emberford or is taken by the Heron.
- **EDGES:** R-050, R-051, R-052, R-053, R-093 · targeted by R-011, R-017, R-041, R-045, R-095
- **STATUS:** alive · Emberford, the Lamplit (Glimmerway) and the Grane house on Crownhill · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /sealed/art/portraits/npc-005-clara-grane.jpg (move to /art/portraits/ when the player meets them)

```
NPC-006 · Master Hollis Grane (aka Hollace Grain, Hollis Grain, Holis · inside the Calm: "the Keeper of the Still Lamp")
Tier 1 · FAC-02 (Guildmaster) · FAC-01 (Concord seat) · FAC-03 (the Calm, leader) · First seen: Ch2, Enchanters' Row
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Guildmaster of the Enchanters, a Concord member, kindly and grey-bearded, plain-spoken and rich. Funds Lyceum scholarships (Zeke's, twice), lamps for poor streets and Lamp House. Beloved.
- **TRUTH:** River fever took his wife Clara and son Edmund in one week in YF 1079. In his grief he heard the Stillness in a glimmer lamp promising an end to every loss, and has served it sincerely ever since. He leads the Calm (SEC-04). He ordered the Fenwick barge fire in YF 1085 ("Bring me the child. The parents must not be able to follow."), took the girl, and believes she is the only heir. He is over-mining Kessel and tuning the Grand Reserve through Clara's Voice for Lantern Night. He carries real guilt and has buried it under his cause.
- **WANTS:** No more fathers burying children. The Stillness's peace over Emberford, then the realm. Hester kept in the light.
- **FEARS:** Hester's disappointment. Grief. That he was wrong, and the fire was for nothing.
- **HIDING:** SEC-04, SEC-05, SEC-03 (he holds it, believing it's the only heir)
- **ANSWERS TO:** the Stillness, heard through still water and glimmer. Knows who's really in charge? Y. He believes it's mercy.
- **VOICE:** Warm, unhurried, a little rough. Remembers everyone's name. Rests a hand on your shoulder. Says "my dear" and "every grief an end." *"Our scholarship boy! Will we see you back next term? And who's this? A Fenwick too, I'd wager. Here. For your trouble."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY:** start: genuinely warm to Zeke; Ash is a nobody · up if: (outwardly) the brothers accept his help · down if: Ash's lamps flare (EVT-40), the rescue reveals a second heir (EVT-10) · breaks if: Hester dies (EVT-21). That's the only thing that reaches him.
- **ARC:** Ch2 kindly man on the Row · Ch5 tells Hester a soothing lie (EVT-41) · Ch7 learns a second heir lives; sends the listening-lamp · Ch11 the offer to Zeke and Gideon (EVT-51); tells Clara "those Fenwick boys are troubled" · Ch12 his order is found · Ch13 lights the Reserve; Hester dies; killed, captured or reached (EVT-24) · Ch17 testifies if reached (EVT-54).
- **EDGES:** R-044, R-045, R-046, R-047, R-048, R-049 · targeted by R-007, R-015, R-040, R-050, R-054, R-055, R-060, R-090, R-091, R-094
- **STATUS:** alive · Emberford, the Guildhall (Enchanters' wing) and the Grane house on Crownhill · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-006-hollis-grane.jpg

```
NPC-007 · Hester Grane (aka Hestor, Esther Grane, "Mistress Grane," "Aunt Hester" to the orphans)
Tier 1 · FAC-01 orbit (Lamp House is city-funded) · First seen: Ch2, Lamp House or the Willow Lane bread round
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Hollis's older sister, 58. Runs Lamp House, the city orphanage on Temple Isle. Has fed half the Fringe. A local hero. Brusque, tireless, kind with her hands rather than her words.
- **TRUTH:** She's exactly as good as she looks, with one blind spot (SEC-10). She knows Hollis has secret evening meetings, that some children he "placed" were never heard from again, and that he weeps at still water. She has chosen not to look, because looking would end the only family she has. She will vouch for him sincerely, twice, and believe his lies more each time she's challenged.
- **WANTS:** Every child fed and placed. Her brother happy again. Not to know.
- **FEARS:** That Hollis has gone somewhere she can't follow. Empty beds at Lamp House.
- **HIDING:** SEC-10 (from herself most of all)
- **ANSWERS TO:** nobody; the Concord funds Lamp House. Knows who's really in charge? N.
- **VOICE:** Clipped, practical, all imperatives. Wipes her hands on her apron whether they're dirty or not. *"My brother? Hollis would never send men after a frightened creature. Someone's using the Guild's name. I'll ask him myself."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY:** start: friendly to the Fenwicks (she's known them since the fire; sends bread) · up if: they help Lamp House or the Lane's children · down if: they accuse Hollis without proof · breaks if: proof before Ch13 (she goes to Hollis, he lies, she comes back trusting them less and him more; see SEC-10).
- **ARC:** Ch2 the bread round, the parcel · Ch5 vouch #1 (EVT-41) · Ch7 vouch #2, delivers the gift lamp · Ch11 slips about Clara to Gideon at the memorial; notices the matching eye flecks and changes the subject · Ch13 finally looks, gets the Lamp House children out of Old Ford and holds the chapel door. Dies (EVT-21, loss #1). The one costly route that saves her is in campaign/00 §7.
- **EDGES:** R-040, R-041, R-042, R-043 · targeted by R-044, R-051
- **STATUS:** alive · Emberford, Lamp House (Temple Isle) · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-007-hester-grane.jpg

```
NPC-008 · Brannoc Ironhorn, the Horned Regent (aka Brannock, Brannick, Branok, "the Regent")
Tier 1 · FAC-07 (Horned Host, leader) · First seen: Ch2 as Lark's fragment "iron horns"; in person Ch14
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** (In Mirrowen) the iron-hard Regent who conquered half the realm to save the clans from greywilt. Huge, scarred minotaur with iron-capped horns and a war-maul named Answer.
- **TRUTH:** Greywilt was killing his herd-clan's calves. The Stillness, through the Grey Heron, offered to stop it, and he took the deal: obedience, and keeping the Mirrowen Hearkener silent (SEC-07). The calves were "cured" by being Hushed, including his own daughter Ama (SEC-18), who stands empty in the Quiet Pens. He visits her every night. He believes, correctly, that Eyrland's glimmer mining is draining Mirrowen. He doesn't know Hollis exists.
- **WANTS:** His people's children alive. The Tall Folk to stop stealing the song. For Ama to look at him once.
- **FEARS:** That the cure was a lie. That he's become what he fought.
- **HIDING:** SEC-07, SEC-18, SEC-13 (holds Lark)
- **ANSWERS TO:** the Grey Heron, whom he believes is a holy messenger. Knows who's really in charge? N.
- **VOICE:** Deep, slow, formal. Says "Tall Folk." Touches the iron cap on his left horn before he makes a promise. *"You came under the banner. Good. Then you'll hear me first, little hearer, and after that I'll decide whether to hear you."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY:** start: unaware → hostile once Lark is freed (EVT-08) · up if: courage, honesty under truce, proof about glimmer, waking Ama · down if: treachery under a truce banner, harming calves · breaks if: the party kills Ama or betrays a parley (he never turns).
- **ARC:** Ch6 offstage: Stillwater Keep is his; the ribboned calf · Ch6–7 sends hunters (EVT-09) · Ch8 raids · Ch13 his scouts wait at the Ford Pool · Ch14 declares war (EVT-27); the parley (EVT-28) · Ch15 Ama wakes, he breaks and turns (EVT-29/30) · Ch16 fights beside the Free Clans · Ch20 his host holds the Gap if turned.
- **EDGES:** R-076, R-077, R-078, R-079 · targeted by R-075, R-080, R-085
- **STATUS:** alive · Mirrowen, the siege lines at Tuskhold / Cairn Answer · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /sealed/art/portraits/npc-008-brannoc-ironhorn.jpg (sealed until Ch14)

```
NPC-009 · Vessimer, the Grey Heron (aka Vessimar, Vesimer, Vessamer, "the bird that doesn't blink")
Tier 1 · FAC-07 (adviser) · FAC-14 (corrupted Warden) · First seen: Ch2 as a fragment; voice Ch7; in person Ch15
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** (In Mirrowen) the Regent's holy messenger, a grey heron taller than a minotaur, calm and cold.
- **TRUTH:** A Firstbeast, the Warden of still waters, corrupted by the Stillness (SEC-08). She is its herald and the voice Hollis hears in still water. She remembers Mossoran as a brother. She sincerely believes stillness is kindness. Buried deep, she wants to be forgiven, and can be redeemed (SEC-19).
- **WANTS:** The world to be at peace, meaning still. Lark silent. Buried: to feel rain again.
- **FEARS:** Change. Her brother's grief. The ache she can't name ("Why does this hurt?").
- **HIDING:** SEC-08, SEC-19 (unknowingly)
- **ANSWERS TO:** Omeruth, the Stillness (ENT-01). Knows who's really in charge? Y.
- **VOICE:** Very quiet, every word level. Never blinks. Calls Moss "Brother." *"Give her back, little hearer. She was at peace."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY:** start: unaware → patient, pitying hostility · up if: Moss faces her without hate, Ash sings to her instead of striking · down if: the Pens are woken, Lark sings · breaks if: (toward redemption) Ash's song plus Moss's mercy at Ch18.
- **ARC:** Ch6 away; her return is the escape's clock; "Brother, you've grown small" (Route B) · Ch7 speaks through still water · Ch15 first fight; withdraws; "Brother. Why does this hurt?" (EVT-26) · Ch18 opens the Greymarsh gate; final fight; redeemed or destroyed (EVT-35) · Ch19 if redeemed, wakes Ommu with a cry.
- **EDGES:** R-082, R-083, R-084 · targeted by R-012, R-076
- **STATUS:** alive · Mirrowen, Cairn Answer / the Glass Mere · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /sealed/art/portraits/npc-009-vessimer.jpg (sealed until she appears)

```
NPC-010 · Rook (real name Danny Pratt; aka Rooke, Ruk, Rouk, Dan Pratt, Danny)
Tier 1 · FAC-06 (the Magpies, leader) · First seen: Ch1, top of Willow Lane
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Ash's lifelong rival, 21, two lanes over. Leader of the Magpies. Quick hands, quicker mouth. Steals from anyone, including the Fringe.
- **TRUTH:** Every coin goes to his mother Martha's lung-rot doctor first and his boots second. He'd never say so. From Ch5 the Calm pays him through Sergeant Mabry to watch Ash (SEC-14). He takes it for the money, then realizes what he's in. Redemption or fall depends on Ash.
- **WANTS:** Out of the Fringe. His mum breathing. To beat Ash once, clean.
- **FEARS:** Being nobody. His mum's cough at night. The grey around Mabry's eyes.
- **HIDING:** SEC-14
- **ANSWERS TO:** Sgt. Giles Mabry (NPC-023), from Ch5. Knows who's really in charge? N. He thinks it's "some Guild man."
- **VOICE:** Sharp, sneering, calls Ash "Fenwick." Flips a coin across his knuckles. *"Everyone's bought, Fenwick. You just haven't had the right offer."*
- **ATTITUDE TO PARTY (to Ash):** start: hostile-competitive · up if: Ash helps him in the flood, helps Martha, beats him fairly and doesn't gloat · down if: Ash humiliates him in public, snitches on him · breaks if: Ash lets Martha suffer when he could help (he goes fully Calm).
- **ARC:** Ch1 hunts Thistle for the Bucket · Ch2 the parcel chase · Ch4 sabotages the Bargerace; carries his mum out in the flood · Ch5 bought (EVT-42) · Ch7 leads the Calm crew over the roofs; hesitates or doesn't (EVT-46) · Ch9–11 brings information or goes half-Hushed · Ch12 steals the fire ledger (redeemed) · Ch13 runs Market Steps, or is a Hushed lamp-warden who can be woken · Ch20 shows up either way.
- **EDGES:** R-037, R-038, R-039 · targeted by R-027, R-056
- **STATUS:** alive · Emberford, the Fringe (two lanes over) · last seen: (not yet played)
- **PORTRAIT:** /art/portraits/npc-010-rook.jpg

```
NPC-011 · Bess Carter (aka Bes, Beth Carter, Bessie, "Widow Carter")
Tier 1 · FAC-05 · First seen: opener / Ch1, her doorstep
```
- **PUBLIC FACE:** Widowed washerwoman with two kids, Pip (9) and Nell (5). Always tired, always proud. Takes in washing from Crownhill.
- **TRUTH:** Exactly that. Someone has been leaving food and coin on her step for two years and she has no idea it's Ash (she thinks it might be the Bright Lady's charity, or Hester). Everyone else on the Lane suspects Ash. Nobody tells her.
- **WANTS:** Her kids fed and warm. Not to need charity. To know who to thank.
- **FEARS:** The workhouse. Nell's cough. Pip running with the wrong crowd (Rook's).
- **HIDING:** nothing
- **ANSWERS TO:** nobody. Knows who's really in charge? N/A.
- **VOICE:** Quick and tired, kind under the edges. Pushes damp hair off her forehead with her wrist. *"Pip, get out from under the Fenwick boy's feet. Ash, love, you look starved. Sit. There's soup. Don't argue."*

## NON-PERSON ENTITIES (not counted in Tier 1)

```
ENT-01 · Omeruth, the Stillness (aka Omerooth, Omeroth, Omeruthe, "the Quiet under the water")
Ancient Threat · First felt: Ch1 (grey still water) · In body: Ch20
```
- Primordial silence from before the first river, older than any god or underworld. It soothes, and its touch Hushes. It can't act while sealed: it works through grief (Hollis), desperation (Brannoc) and corruption (Vessimer). See world/00 §6.
- **Answers to:** nothing. **Edges:** none. It doesn't have relationships; it has instruments.

```
ENT-02 · Thalassa-Ommu, the Deep Tortoise (aka Thalassa, Old Ommu, "the Island that Sleeps")
Firstbeast · FAC-14 · Sleeping under Ommu's Rest · Woken: Ch19 (EVT-39)
```
- Keeps the prison's sea side. Her shell is the finale's battlefield. See world/00 §5.

- **NPC-003 Moss:** Hart stat blocks: Tier 2 story form `chapters/act1/ch06.md` §9; Act III full ally block `chapters/act3/ch16.md`.
